blocks.content: Course: Rapid Build With Claude Code
SpeedBlip has two separate navigation components:

items: Sidebar - renders on screens 768px and wider. It is collapsible, with full labels visible when expanded and icon-only when collapsed.
BottomNav - renders on screens smaller than 768px. It sits at the bottom of the viewport with four icon + label pairs.

blocks.content: This decision had to be made before building the navigation chunk. If I had started coding the sidebar first and then tried to retrofit a bottom nav, I would have created two different navigation states that needed to stay in sync - a nightmare of shared state and conditional rendering.

Because both components were planned and named before Chunk 2a, Claude Code built them as separate, independent components that share only the route configuration. Each component manages its own appearance, and the app layout decides which one to render based on screen width.

blocks.alt: Component tree diagram showing AppLayout at top, branching to Sidebar (768px+) and BottomNav (below 768px), both reading from the same navigation config
